svg.text: Reliable AI Application Architecture: 2021–2023 Prototype Baseline vs. 2026 Production Standard
From Prompt-Only Wrappers & Blind HTTP 200 Trust to CFG Constrained Decoding, Guarded Semantic Caches, Bounded Agents & OTel GenAI
Architectural Dimension
2021–2023 Prototype / Early Wrapper Era
2026 Production Reliable AI Standard
1. Output Reliability
& Contract Parsing
"Please return valid JSON only" + regex / try-catch JSON.parse
Prose wrappers, hallucinated fields, and markdown fences break
downstream consumers; silent coercion masks missing fields
CFG/FSM Constrained Decoding + Mandatory Validator Sandwich
XGrammar/llguidance masking + finish_reason check + bounded
retry + Bottom Bun for numeric bounds, invariants & citations
2. Caching & Spend
Admission Control
RPM-only limiters + raw body hash or unguarded cosine >= 0.92
Huge prompts bypass RPM caps; body-only keys leak across tenants;
naive cosine merges "cancel" & "do not cancel" into false hits
Atomic RPM+TPM+USD Limiters + Prefix & Slot-Guarded Cache
Fail-closed Lua quotas + provider prefix caching + conjunctive
semantic cache (tenant, provenance, slots & read guardrail)
3. Uncertainty &
HITL Escalation
Blind HTTP 200 trust or verbalized JSON {"confidence": 0.95}
Silent drift drops accuracy from 95% to 71% over months while
uncalibrated self-reported scores stay overconfident near 0.95
Calibrated Logprob/Verifier Routing + Cost-Matrix HITL Queues
Temperature-scaled uncertainty + ECE drives 4-way routing with
capacity-bounded HITL diff UI & golden eval write-back loop
4. Resilience & Agent
Execution Bounds
Single-provider SDK calls, unbounded ReAct loops, prompt AuthZ
Retry storms & infinite tool loops burn $5k/day; indirect prompt
injection tricks agents into executing privileged write tools
Multi-Provider Breakers + Bounded Loops + Tool-Boundary AuthZ
Outcome-aware breakers + fallback ladder + S_max/T_max/C_max
ceilings + recursive cycle hash + principal tool AuthZ (LLM06)
5. Observability &
Release Governance
Ad-hoc console.log(prompt) + moving model aliases (no CI evals)
Logs leak raw customer PII; moving model aliases silently shift
behavior overnight with zero trace lineage or regression gate
OTel GenAI SemConv Spans (NO_CONTENT) + Pinned Eval CI Gates
Structured gen_ai.* traces + TTFT/TPOT + PSI drift monitors +
pinned model snapshots gated by statistical tolerance bands
Key Architectural Takeaway: Reliability Is an Architectural Envelope, Never a Prompt Property
• An LLM is a non-deterministic sampler (even at temperature=0 due to FP non-associativity and MoE batching). Determinism must be reintroduced
at every boundary: authenticated principals at ingress, cheap spend gates before inference, hard loop/USD ceilings inside agents, and a mandatory
Bottom Bun output validator on EVERY egress path (fresh model outputs, cache reads, and typed degraded fallbacks).
